instrument: Champaign County Zoning Case 196-AT-26 (data center moratorium)
summary: Twelve-month moratorium on data centers with 10,000 square feet or more of processing area in unincorporated Champaign County. ELUC cut the term to nine months on April 9; the full Board restored twelve months and adopted it April 23 2026.
notes: Derived expiry about April 23 2027 (confirm effective date). A Data Center Activities Task Force was created February 5 2026 by ELUC; the 'Big Data Centers' text amendment was tabled February 5. The Oct 8 ELUC / Oct 15 ZBA / Nov 5 ELUC / Nov 10 COW path is from prior reporting, not re-verified.
